purpose.summary: Reads customer registration records from CADCLI.DAT, validates each record (CPF digit check, name, Brazilian state code, city, email), writes valid records to CADOK.DAT, and prints a report of inconsistent/invalid records to RELOCOR with page headers.

notable_features: CPF (Brazilian tax ID) validation with two-digit check digit algorithm using COMPUTE, MULTIPLY, DIVIDE REMAINDER
88-level condition for all 27 Brazilian state codes
OCCURS on elementary PIC 9 for digit-by-digit CPF processing
VALUE OF FILE-ID for PC-style file assignment
WRITE ... AFTER ADVANCING PAGE / LINE for report formatting
No COMP-3, no EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS
verdict.notes: Authored by 'FABIO COSTA' at FATEC-SP (a Brazilian technical college) in October 2015, clearly a student assignment. Minor typo: 'OMMITED' instead of 'OMITTED'. The CPF validation logic resets CTR1/CTR2 between the two passes but the SOMA1/SOMA2 paragraphs share the same counters, which may have a subtle bug (CTR2 starts at 10 for SOMA1 but should start at 10 for 9 iterations covering digits 1-9, then resets to 11 for SOMA2 covering digits 1-10 — logic appears intentional but unusual). Overall a well-structured student program.
